stem: Why was the development of electric lighting important to the economic development of the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: It limited production to certain geographic regions.

options.label: B
options.text: It increased the need for producers to manage costs.

options.label: C
options.text: It expanded the available hours for production.

options.label: D
options.text: It lowered the cost of energy for manufacturers.
